name: Nano-Biotechnology for Environmental Remediation
description: Introduction on nanomaterials use for contaminants removal; nanomaterials-related processes for remediation (adsorption, aggregation, advanced oxidation, co-precipitation); removal due to nanomaterials-plant system; removal due to nanomaterials-microbes system; sustainability assessment; case studies for application of nanobiotechnology for remediation.
